d:
There are some dishes that belong to a season, a memory, a kitchen that smells like home. Undhiyu is one of them. A slow-cooked Gujarati winter classic, made with fresh surti papdi, raw banana, purple yam, and a fistful of methi muthiya - all cooked together until the flavours stop being separate things and become one. This is that recipe. The one worth waiting all year for
Detailed ingredient list:
For the Undhiyu
Surti Papdi (flat beans) 250g
Valor (field beans), shelled 200g
Sweet potato, peeled and thickly sliced 1
Small eggplants (brinjal) 5-6
Fresh green peas, shelled 1 cup
